label: On the Immortality of the Soul
summary: Marsilio Ficino's Platonic Theology, or a related theological and philosophical work.

claims.statement: Entered as no. 47 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Religion, Philosophy and History. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "the immortality of the soul".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Theologia Platonica de immortalitate animorum. The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
Composition and printing as given in the reconstruction: Composed 1469 to 1474 · Printed 1482.
check_in: ISTC (Incunabula Short Title Catalogue) or Edit16 record for the edition
